did: Coordinator for the Nov 12 run. I wrote no code. You asked why make compose pull render was still on your list; it wasn't needed any more, since make home-deploy already pulls every image the release names, and call-stage had to go with docker rm because compose no longer knew it. After your voiced call and Rust essay previews rendered, you asked for Renders to show what home makes. Two sessions redesigned it: previews on home's board, every row named in plain words and opening its page, a question before Make a preview, and each render moving along pizza-named stations with the scene it is recording, which you approved from the prototype. I merged the four pull requests once I had checked each head, its runs and its review myself, then the www and server image pull requests, pushed both sessions' notes, and kept the ledger.
